title: Strict open total tensor coefficient coherence predicate
statement: For normalized open total-tensor coefficient comparisons [def-sf-open-total-tensor-coefficient-data] [def-sf-open-total-tensor-coefficient-normalization], strict coherence is the following data and properties. The left and right composites are equal as $A$-linear chain maps for every unital coefficient algebra $A$ and every pair of unbounded complexes. Their forward value on $([x]_f\otimes y)\otimes a$ is $[(x\otimes a|)\otimes(j^*y\otimes1)]_f$, and the inverse value on $[(x\otimes a|)\otimes(j^*y\otimes b)]_f$ multiplies the coefficients $ab$. The source and target are strict coefficient families whose transitions act on the displayed generators by applying the coefficient algebra map to one and two scalar entries respectively. Both composites are strict natural isomorphisms for these families. Their restrictions along every inverse tower are equal, and the equality remains after transposition and localization in the derived category of strict module towers. The comparison is natural in chain maps of both complexes.
